खट् {c1c} P. (खटति) To desire;
wish.

खट्ट् {c10c} P. (खट्टयति) To cover,
screen.

खाट्(त्) ind. The sound made
in clearing the throat; खात्कृ to
clear the throat.

खटः [खट्-अच्]
1 Phlegm.
--2 A
blind well.
--3 A hatchet.
--4 A
plough.
--5 Grass.
--6 The closed
fist.
--7 A kind of blow or wound.
--Comp.
--कटाहकः a spitting-box.
--खादकः {1} a jackal. {2} a crow.
{3} an animal. {4} a glass-vessel.
{5} an eater.

खाटः --टा, --टिका --टी f. A bier,
a bedstead on which dead bodies
are carried to the cemetery.

1 A man whose business
is to negotiate marriages; cf. घटक.
--2 The half-closed hand.
--3 The
doubled fist of wrestlers or boxers.

खटकामुखं A particular position
of the hand in shooting.
--खः A
man in the attitude of shooting.

खटिकः The hand half-closed.
--का
1 Chalk.
--2 The external
opening of the ear.

1 A butcher.
--2 A hunter,
fowler.
--का
1 A small bedstead, a
cot.
--2 A bier.

खट(ड)क्किका A side-door,
window.
खटिनी, खटी Chalk.
खटिनी, खटी Chalk.

खाटः --टा, --टिका --टी f. A bier,
a bedstead on which dead bodies
are carried to the cemetery.

खट्टन a. Dwarfish.
--नः A dwarf.

1 A bedstead.
--2 A kind
of grass.

खाटः --टा, --टिका --टी f. A bier,
a bedstead on which dead bodies
are carried to the cemetery.
खट्टाशः --शी The civet-cat.
खट्टाशः --शी The civet-cat.
खट्टिः m. f. A bier.

खाटिः [खट् वा˚ इन्]
1 A bier.
--2 A scar.
--3 Caprice, whim.
खट्टेरक a. Dwarfish.
खट्वा [खट्-क्वुन्; cf.

]
1 A bedstead, couch, cot.
--2 A
swing, hammock.
--3 A kind of
bandage.
--Comp.
--अंगः {1} a club
or staff with a skull at the top
considered as the weapon of Śiva and
carried by ascetics and Yogins;

. {2} N. of Dilīpa. ˚धर,
भृत् an epithet of Śiva.
--अंगिन्
m. an epithet of Śiva.
--आप्लुत,
--आरूढ a. {1} lying on a bed. {2} low,
vile {3} abandoned, wicked. {4}
silly, stupid. {5} erring, going
wrong or astray.

खट्वयति Den. P. To use as a
couch; Śi. 2. 77.
खट्वाका, खट्विका A small bedstead.
